tbesh_html:
Nobah = "barking"
a place in Gilead which comprised the towns of Kenath and its surrounding villages named after its conqueror; area eventually regained its original identity
Another name of qe.nat (קְנָת "Kenath" H7079)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan
